question: If 3x – 2y = 10 and xy = 11, the value of 27x³ - 8y³ is __________
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the identity: **a³ − b³ = (a − b)³ + 3ab(a − b)**

Here, a = 3x and b = 2y, so (a − b) = 10 and 3ab = 3(3x)(2y) = 18xy.

Substitute values: 10³ + 18(11)(10) = 1000 + 1980 = 2980.

**∴ The correct answer is 2980.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 3x − 2y = 10 and xy = 11

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/426185eadd164bc16f551c60dec644e8c2497e9fe50c639ba1be0aa42ae437f1.png] 

Using the **algebraic identity** for cubes:

(a − b)³ = a³ − b³ − 3ab(a − b)

Let a = 3x and b = 2y.

⇒ (3x − 2y)³ = (3x)³ − (2y)³ − 3(3x)(2y)(3x − 2y)

⇒ (3x − 2y)³ = 27x³ − 8y³ − 18xy(3x − 2y)

Substitute the **given values** into the equation:

⇒ (10)³ = 27x³ − 8y³ − 18 × 11 × 10

⇒ 1000 = 27x³ − 8y³ − 1980

⇒ 27x³ − 8y³ = 1000 + 1980

⇒ 27x³ − 8y³ = 2980

**∴ The correct answer is 2980.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cube of a Sum

The identity for the cube of a sum is (a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b).

Difference of Two Cubes

The expression a³ − b³ can also be factored as (a − b)(a² + ab + b²).

Sum of Two Cubes

The expression a³ + b³ can be factored as (a + b)(a² − ab + b²).</p
